notes: RBox revision of the topic's transitivity slot: 'is more massive than' (catalogued in staging/physics-replace-rbox.RELATIONS.md, transitive) loses transitivity. Thermal equilibrium was the natural transitive relation but the dev split already removes its transitivity (physics-delete-d003), so it is avoided here (Rule 4). The instances use real mass orderings whose conclusions are not written as sentences (0 exact hits), each with 'Given only these facts' so that stored superlatives cannot settle the answer. The direct question glosses 'transitive'. Yes and no are balanced through phrasing: the first instance asks 'does it follow' (yes, then no), the second 'could it be that not' (no, then yes). The negation is the plain opposite of the edit ('is the relation transitive?': yes, then no), since the edit itself contains the negation. hops counts the instance facts in the prompt as one bridge (1 + 1).
